title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
hints: Two equal halves means some subset sums to total / 2. If the total is odd, stop. Otherwise this is subset-sum with target total / 2, which is a 0/1 knapsack.
reachable[t] = can some subset sum to t. For each number x, set reachable[t] |= reachable[t - x] for t from target down to x. Why does the loop direction matter?
The same thing in one line per number with a Python int as a bitset: bits |= bits << x, and the answer is (bits >> target) & 1.
